title: A Group Analogue of the Ghurye--Olkin--Ibragimov Theorem
summary: According to the classical Skitovich--Darmois theorem, the Gaussian distribution on the real line is characterized by the independence of two linear forms of a finite number of independent random variables $ξ_j$. This theorem has been extended in various directions. In particular, S.G. Ghurye and I. Olkin established an analogous result for the case where $ξ_j$ are $n$-dimensional independent random vectors and the coefficients of the linear forms are invertible $n\times n$ matrices.
